items.text: How are preoperative anaemia pathways for elective hip and knee replacement organised, in terms of screening point, referral triggers, clinic leadership, treatments offered and times from screening to treatment and surgery?
items.population: Adults awaiting elective hip or knee replacement
items.concept: Organisation of preoperative anaemia pathways: screening point, triggers, leadership, treatments and times
items.context: Hospitals and health systems offering elective joint replacement

finer: Feasible with two residents and a librarian; interesting to the planning committee; novel in its focus on pathway organisation; ethical as a review; relevant because the pathway will be funded in 2027.
summary: One PCC question for the scoping review.
